title: Visitor and Room
author: Ansel Crane
blurb: Oscar Thackeray, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in before the last resident signs the papers.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
